claim: Nikon lists the CFI Plan Apochromat Lambda D 4X (MRD70040) as a Plan Apochromat objective, primary technique Brightfield, air, for 0-0.17 mm cover glass, with no correction collar listed, no spring-loaded front listed, Ti2-E PFS compatible; applications marked: Clinical / Laboratory, Confocal, Research.
validity_conditions: The model as Nikon publishes it on https://www.microscope.healthcare.nikon.com/products/optics/selector/comparison/-179794, read 2026-09-24. Technique ratings as the page words them: Brightfield: recommended for best results; Fluorescence (visible): recommended for best results; Fluorescence (NIR): recommended for best results. NA and working distance are in objective_mrd70040 and are not repeated here. A property the page leaves blank is not listed, which is not the same as the page saying the objective lacks it.
